intro.text: A popular ride at Kilahito's carnival, in which two-person pods are carried up a tall steel post, over the top and down the far side.

description.text: The ride moves slowly and stops now and then, giving riders at the top time to take in the view while others climb aboard below.
When Yumi and Nikaro go on the Jotun Line, they are waved to the front of the long queue because Yumi is taken for a working painter.
